browse.title: Feature flags
browse.description: Runtime toggles. A tenant override wins over the system value.
browse.empty_description: Modules declare flags via register_feature_flags(); install one to see it here.
browse.viewing_system: Viewing system-level flags — every tenant follows these unless it overrides them.
browse.viewing_tenant: Viewing overrides for tenant {tenant_id} — unset flags follow the system value.
browse.audit_note: Every toggle is written to the audit log with the actor and the previous value.

confirm.scope_system: This changes the value for every tenant, immediately.
confirm.scope_tenant: This sets an override for tenant “{tenant_id}” only. Other tenants keep following the system value.
